contexts.text: But adult women, who have been harlots, and have decoyed other women, do not undergo vastation, but are in Hell.

(Tamar) covered herself with a veil as a bride, and not as a harlot; although Judah believed it, because harlots were then wont to cover their faces in like manner. The reason Judah accounted her such, was that the Jewish nation... regarded the internal truths of the representative Church no otherwise than as a harlot; and therefore Judah was conjoined with her as a harlot, but not so Tamar with him.
Where is that harlot? () = whether it was falsity. A harlot, or harlot, = falsity.
There was no harlot there () = that it was not falsity.
(The Spirits of the Second Earth) added, that harlots are found there; but that... when they become Spirits they are witches, and are cast into Hell.
The harlot with the dead horse signified the falsification of the Word by many at this day, by which all the understanding of truth perishes; the harlot signified falsification.
Thus thinks the understanding, which is then the harlot of the will...

As an adulterer loves a noble woman as a harlot... but of whom he thinks when by himself at home, that she is nothing but a vile harlot... His internal man is that adulterer; and his external man is this woman.
He is then led more interiorly into the cavern, where there are harlots, and each is allowed to take one of them for a woman, and is forbidden under a penalty to scortate promiscuously. TCR 281.
With the men there, all the nerves sink at the sight of a harlot.
The man is then delivered over to some harlot...
Then such things inflow as are contrary to the Church... the consequence of which is heat for harlots...
They are carried to harlots, who by phantasy can assume supereminent beauty... These harlots are called Sirens.
They are cast down into the Hell... beneath the Hell of the more cunning harlots.
Brothels are opened to them, which are at the side of Hell, where there are harlots...
They are afterwards sent to the most cunning harlots...
After this, there is a way opened to them to a certain troop of harlots, who have learned most astutely to counterfeit innocence...
Then harlots were seen who were awaiting them...
Thus also their wives become harlots, caring nothing... for the procreation of offspring.
A harlot = heresy.
A harlot falsity.
Hosea... was commanded to take to himself a harlot as a wife... to represent the then quality of the Church.
To give a boy for a harlot () = to falsify the truths of the Word.
Foully sticky Hells for those to whom varieties and changes of harlots had been the delights.
There were cottages... in which at first they dwell solitary with some harlot.
